pages.title: In-World Guidance
pages.text: Patchouli is required, and this Field Guide is craftable from Book + Plant Fibre. Optional Jade supplies station requirements, progress, heat, and air feedback. The base mod also provides interaction hints.

pages.title: Recipe Browsing
pages.text: Optional JEI supplies barrel, spinning, weaving, molding, grinding, workshop, kiln-heating, and charcoal information. Its current recipes are useful when a pack overrides bundled defaults.

pages.title: KubeJS
pages.text: Optional KubeJS supports custom wood registration, custom recipes, and cancellable start/completion hooks. A pack can deny starting. Tick-driven crucible cancellation is latched to avoid per-tick events until relevant state changes or restoking.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.text: Check input count, catalyst, output, working part, heat, ignition, and airflow before assuming a bug. Packs may disable or replace a route. Removed Loom weave/changeShed script calls do not bypass the authoritative held shuttle interaction.
